heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(1), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1458

notes.text: Section 2721, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLVI, § 4621, formerly Pub. L. 101–189, div. C, title XXXI, § 3142, Nov. 29, 1989, 103 Stat. 1680; renumbered Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLVI, § 4621, and amended Pub. L. 108–136, div. C, title XXXI, § 3141(i)(8), Nov. 24, 2003, 117 Stat. 1778; Pub. L. 113–66, div. C, title XXXI, § 3146(g)(6), Dec. 26, 2013, 127 Stat. 1080, required establishment and implementation of an executive management training program in the Department of Energy. See section 6251 of Title 10, Armed Forces.

Section 2722, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLVI, § 4622, formerly Pub. L. 103–337, div. C, title XXXI, § 3131, Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 3085; renumbered Pub. L. 107–314, div. L. 113–66, div. C, title XXXI, § 3146(g)(7), Dec. 26, 2013, 127 Stat. 1080, related to a stockpile stewardship recruitment and training program at the national security laboratories. See section 6252 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
